cues.text: Can dogs eat apples? Good news. Yes, with three simple rules.
One. Remove the core, seeds and stem.
Two. Plain, thin slices. No sugar.
Three. It's a treat, not a meal. Start small.
Not sure about a food? Ask PETTO. It remembers your dog's allergies. And if you're worried, ask your vet.
PETTO. Free on iOS and Android.
